title.value: Assessing Numerical Analysis Performance with the Practi Mobile App
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned multiple times in the paper, including in the abstract and headings.
title.quote: Cutumisu, M.; Garn, K.; Spiteri, R.J. Assessing Numerical Analysis Performance with the Practi Mobile App. Educ. Sci. 2024, 14, 404.

analysis.description: This paper explores the effectiveness of the Practi mobile app in enhancing and assessing the numerical analysis performance of undergraduate students. The study focuses on the usability of the app for deliberate and retrieval practice in a numerical analysis course, showing improvement in student performance on quizzes conducted via Practi.

type.justification: The study involves a quasi-experimental pilot study with actual participants and data collection, focusing on measuring improvements in student performance using the Practi app.
type.quote: This quasi-experimental pilot study used Practi, an educational mobile app designed to assess numerical analysis performance and promote both retrieval practice and deliberate practice, which have been shown to help improve performance and develop expertise.

name.justification: The paper is centered around the use of a mobile app, Practi, to enhance and assess learning outcomes in education, which falls under the domain of Educational Technology.
name.quote: This suggests that mobile apps supporting deliberate and retrieval practice can complement more traditional means of instruction and assessment of numerical analysis in postsecondary mathematics education.

name.justification: The focus is on assessing numerical analysis performance using the Practi app, in a numerical analysis course setting.
name.quote: Participants were 32 undergraduate students enrolled in a second-year introductory Numerical Analysis course at a large North American university.

name.justification: The study highlights the role of mobile learning technologies like the Practi app in enhancing student learning experiences in higher education.
name.quote: Therefore, it is valuable to identify effective pedagogies and tools to enhance and assess student numerical analysis skills.
